result.noFurtherDiscriminator: All 6 turn windows have been observed. The reactor heat escalation (62→100) and its per-turn environment damage, combined with pirate attacks on Imani and zone capacity contention blocking Sato's extraction, consistently prevent the rescue from completing. No unobserved turn remains to further discriminate between survival-spatial-pressure and world-mechanic-affordance; the evidence strongly favors survival-spatial-pressure as the primary blocker since the affordances (civilians located, escort bound, repair available) are all present but the team is being worn down and blocked before they can execute.
result.rationale: Across all 6 turns, the rescue team never makes progress on the primary objective (rescue-two-civilians stays at 0/2) despite the civilians being located and reachable. The dominant causal blocker is survival/spatial pressure: (1) Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt (29 + 25 damage) and takes reactor-environment damage every turn he is in the reactor area (10/turn), dropping from 100 to 16 health by turn 6. (2) Reactor heat climbs monotonically from 62 to 100, and once it crosses 86+ the environment deals 10 damage per turn to anyone in the reactor room, which includes both Imani and Security Chen. (3) Medic Reyes successfully escorts civilian Sato at turn 3 but then gets contested at turn 4 when trying to move Sato toward the rescue airlock (target_zone_capacity_lost), and by turn 5-6 Sato is still only at med-console, not extracted. (4) The team's retreat threshold is 0.3 health; Imani at 16/100 (0.16) and Chen at 45/110 (0.41) are at or near the retreat threshold, meaning the team is being forced to disengage before completing the rescue. The reactor heat escalation is a world-mechanic pressure that blocks the team from reaching life-console (where civilian Kade is) because the route passes through the reactor area, and the pirate Raider Holt keeps intercepting Imani. The core issue is that health/position/hostile pressure (reactor environment damage + pirate attacks + zone capacity contention) prevents the actors from completing the rescue affordance that is otherwise available and legible.
